node.title: Official exact-slice structured moment/pullback column budget
node.statement: At every official exact-list corridor row, let A=K+t_XR and partition each full locator-prefix fiber by one declared support-wise first-match rule. After the quotient and dihedral owners, let M_z be the actual set of list supports assigned to the structured non-quotient moment-null/U2-boundary pullback bucket, including every staircase expansion and after parameter-image coalescing. Prove max_z |M_z|<=N^3=2^123. This is a structured Q/MT column, disjoint from the primitive star-PTE residue owned by u1. A census of t_XR-null generator blocks or families does not by itself prove the claim: it must also prove the expansion, first ownership, maximum-prefix transport, and coalescing needed to count actual list members. The guarded F2 terminal and null-fiber near-tail payments remain evidence for that structured-column proof, not substitutes for its quantifiers.
node.falsifier: An official corridor row, locator prefix z, and certified first-match structured moment/U2 pullback bucket containing more than N^3 actual list supports after expansion and coalescing, or an unbounded expansion multiplicity omitted by the proposed ledger.
